auto_mpg.note: Auto MPG / Xmdv Car source. Rows with missing horsepower are removed, matching P-Lite Table 4.

cereal_full.note: Full 77-row cereal schema (name, manufacturer, type plus 13 measures). This is the schema rendered by the D3 cereal stimulus; an ordinal id is derived from its source-row position for that chart.

cereal_xmdv.note: The original 11-dimension Xmdv/P-Lite cereal archive. Retained separately because it is not the same schema as the D3 stimulus.

college.note: Matches BTPL field names SATAverage, AdmissionRate, AverageCost and MedianDebt.

penguins.note: Palmer Penguins source used by the BTPL-style scatter/PCP correspondence items.

highcharts_runners.note: The exact public data endpoint used by Highcharts' parallel-coordinates demo, which is referenced by the BTPL running-pace item.

coal_disaster.note: Original Xmdv Coal Disaster archive cited in P-Lite Table 4. It establishes lineage but not the BTPL item's undocumented selection/scale transformation.

us_population.note: Original Xmdv US Population archive. The BTPL stimulus uses the complete-record subset beginning in 1950.

county_demographics_2019.note: Historical CORGIS county-demographics revision. It exactly matches the BTPL field schema and displayed four-axis limits; the current CORGIS revision does not.

state_demographics_2019.note: Historical CORGIS state-demographics revision matching the labels and state-scale values in the BTPL Evaluate items.

iris.note: Fisher iris data used by the recognition-style PCP item.

mtcars.note: The canonical 32-row R mtcars data. It matches both the repeated-axis Evaluate stimulus and the named-car, displacement >= 400 Analyze selection.

abalone.note: UCI Abalone data, used by the high-density Evaluate stimuli.

nutrients.note: Dex nutrient data. Its labels and value ranges match the water/fiber/monounsaturated-fat Understand stimulus.

diamonds.note: The ggplot2 diamonds data used by the small categorical PCP recognition stimulus.

ames_housing.note: Ames Housing data, whose GrLivArea and SalePrice fields match the scatterplot-with-marginals recognition item.

hawks.note: Stat2Data Hawks data. Culmen, Hallux, Tail and the CH/RT/SS species codes match the deliberately wrong-legend Evaluate item.
